cases.question: How do I check whether my Ryoku install is healthy?

evidence.title: Run Ryoku Doctor
evidence.answer: Run `ryoku doctor` to inspect supported drift. It is the safe first check before changing system state.

cases.question: Where is the Ryoku CLI implemented?

evidence.title: Ryoku Repository Structure
evidence.answer: The user-facing Ryoku CLI is implemented in the stable source tree under `ryoku/cli/`, with the main dispatcher in `ryoku/cli/main.go`.

sources.snippet: // ryoku = the user-facing CLI for the distro. one front door to updates, rollback, and the shell. It is a thin dispatcher.
